title: melothria racemosa
intro: Melothria racemosa, commonly known as the "Titi fruit" or "Gac fruit", is a type of climber plant belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support eye health, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Melothria racemosa are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
